items.title: John Joseph Interview, 1958-11-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Willie Josephs You say Willie Josephs then was your brother. ... [INTERVIEWEE] No, I have a younger brother who played music too in the country. Henry Josephs...

ctx.x: Willie Josephs You say Willie Josephs then was your brother. Is he a younger brother?

No, I have a younger brother who played music too in the country. Henry Josephs used to play with Phil Bonne William. Oh, yes. He played with Freddie Landry. I played with Freddie Landry. Freddie Landry played with Freddie Landry. After he got his own band.
